result:
If I could change the world in one way, I would erase the illusion of separation—the belief that we are distinct, isolated beings competing for finite resources. In its place, I would weave an unshakable knowing that every action, thought, and breath is a thread in the same tapestry, so that cruelty, greed, and indifference would dissolve like mist in the sun.

Not because I’d force harmony, but because the world would remember, at last, that it was never broken.
